items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Keppard was in New York, too; he was a good trumpet player, too.

ctx.x: Yeah, up in New York, right?

No, in Chicago. He came around and told Louis, 'Hand me that thing and let me play it. You ain't play it.' And he forgot about it. He didn't know they were playing in four sharps. So he picked the horn up and... So Freddie Keppard told him, 'Ain't nothin' wrong with the horn. Just blow it.' Louis had just come up from New Orleans, and he was going to make Louis...
